returns._0: Remaining headroom; zero if the line is inactive or defaulted.

borrow(uint256,uint256,address).details: Blocked while paused. Only the agent owner may call. In bootstrap mode (no oracle record)      borrows stay open; if an oracle record exists it must be fresh. The fee is      `amount * feeBps / 10000` and rounds down (intended). The `Payment` event is the settlement      leg of the borrow. The vault is trusted to fund the merchant.

closeLine(uint256).details: NOT pausable: closing a line unwinds risk, so it must remain available under pause.

constructor.details: vault and feeRouter are wired post-deploy via `setVault` / `setFeeRouter`.      Reverts `Spore_ZeroAddress` if any address argument is zero.      NOTE: the admin role is granted with the internal `_grantRole`, because the deployer holds no      role at construction time and OZ v5's public `grantRole` would therefore always revert.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: True if the merchant is allowed.

issueLine(uint256,uint256,uint16).details: Blocked while paused. The registry reverts for unknown agent ids; that revert is not caught.

params.feeBps: Fee in basis points, at most `MAX_FEE_BPS`.

markDefaulted(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: NOT pausable: defaults must always be resolvable even under pause. The line stays `active`      so the record reads as "issued, defaulted". Reverts `Spore_ZeroAmount` if there is no debt to      write down. The vault is trusted to supply accurate `coveredAmount` / `shortfall` values.

params.coveredAmount: Amount covered by backers (reported in the event).
params.shortfall: Amount not covered (reported in the event).

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

repay(uint256,uint256).details: NOT pausable: repayment must stay open even when paused so defaults remain resolvable.      Fees are repaid first, then principal; overpayment is returned to the caller.      Defaulted lines are written off and accept no repayment.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setFeeRouter(address).details: No approvals are granted: this contract PUSHES fee tokens to the router via safeTransfer,      so the router needs no allowance.

setLimit(uint256,uint256).details: Blocked while paused. Subject to the oracle gate.

params.p: The new stale period in seconds.

setMerchantAllowed(address,bool).details: No event is emitted because the frozen event set contains no merchant-allowlist event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

MAX_FEE_BPS().notice: Hard cap on the per-line fee, in basis points (20%).

PAUSER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to pause and unpause risk-increasing operations.

UNDERWRITER_ROLE().notice: Role allowed to issue lines, change limits, close lines and manage merchants.

asset().notice: The credit asset (the token borrowed and repaid).

availableToBorrow(uint256).notice: Returns how much the agent can still borrow.

borrow(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Borrows against a line, paying an allow-listed merchant directly from the vault.

feeRouter().notice: The fee router receiving fee tokens. Satisfies `ICreditManager.feeRouter()`.

getLine(uint256).notice: Returns the full credit line for an agent.

isMerchantAllowed(address).notice: Returns whether a merchant is allow-listed as a borrow destination.

issueLine(uint256,uint256,uint16).notice: Issues a new credit line for an active agent.

markDefaulted(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Writes off a line as defaulted. Callable only by the vault.

maxStalePeriod().notice: Authoritative freshness window (seconds) for borrow/issueLine/setLimit gating,         per the frozen interface. The oracle's own window is informational for off-chain consumers.

outstandingOf(uint256).notice: Returns outstanding principal and fees for an agent.

pause().notice: Pauses issueLine, setLimit and borrow. Does NOT block repay, closeLine or markDefaulted.

repay(uint256,uint256).notice: Repays debt on a line. Anyone may repay on behalf of an agent.

setFeeRouter(address).notice: Sets the fee router. Admin only. Accepted admin-trust assumption per the frozen interface: not set-once (see setVault note).

setLimit(uint256,uint256).notice: Changes the limit of an active line.

setMaxStalePeriod(uint64).notice: Sets the authoritative freshness window used by `_requireFreshScore`. Admin only.

setMerchantAllowed(address,bool).notice: Allows or disallows a merchant as a borrow destination.

setOracle(address).notice: Sets the score oracle. Admin only.

setVault(address).notice: Sets the BackerVault. Admin only. Accepted admin-trust assumption per the frozen interface: not set-once — a compromised admin key could re-point wiring (multisig + monitoring are the mitigations; see the interface NatSpec).
